verdict.rationale: Workable documents a webhook subscription endpoint for registering your own service. The subscription can be filtered via an `args` object, and Workable notifies the registered subscriber when an event triggers, which is a registrable outbound callback a program can receive. The documented events appear limited to candidate and employee events, and the evidence lacks depth on payloads and delivery. Missing for 10: documentation of the full event catalog, payload schema, signature verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can use this endpoint to register your service. The args object can be used to further filter which candidate events you want to receive.
You can subscribe to an event and Workable will notify you when it's triggered.
